nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a square complex matrix whose rows and columns are indexed by a finite linearly ordered type $n$. Then there are a unitary matrix $U$, with conjugate transpose $U^*$, and a matrix $T$ that is upper triangular with respect to the order on $n$ (that is, $T_{ij} = 0$ whenever $j < i$) such that $A = U T U^*$.
nodes.title: Schur decomposition of a complex square matrix

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a real square matrix with rows and columns indexed by a finite type, and let $b$ be a real vector. Suppose $A$ is strictly diagonally dominant: $\sum_{j \ne i} |A_{ij}| < |A_{ii}|$ for every $i$. Define the Jacobi sweep $J$ by $J(x)_i = \bigl(b_i - \sum_{j \ne i} A_{ij} x_j\bigr) / A_{ii}$. nodes.title: Convergence of the Jacobi method for strictly diagonally dominant matrices

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a field, let $m$ be a set and $n$ a finite set, let $A$ be an $m \times n$ matrix over $K$, and let $b \in K^m$. Then the linear system $Ax = b$ has a solution $x \in K^n$ if and only if the rank of $A$ equals the rank of the augmented matrix $(A \mid b)$, whose columns are the columns of $A$ followed by the single column $b$.
nodes.title: Rouché–Capelli theorem

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
